# IATA.JK — house coverage rates it BUY

Signal: the South Research division published coverage (v4) with a 12-month target of Rp113.0 against Rp72.0 (expected total return 57.1%). Why now: the rating crossed the BUY band on the engine's probability-weighted target.

Archetype guess: dividend_income_anchor · method card: per fund record routing for Coal producers.

Sharpest questions for a thesis:
- The sole load-bearing change is attributed to "the reviewed onshore print of 23 October [S7, corroborated S10]". S7 is the Okezone 26 June 2024 reserves article: greps for "kurs", "USD/IDR", "exchange" and "23 Oktober" r
- The report says "the only driver of that move is the discount rate" for the 6 November (93.924) to 7 November (93.469) change. Model history shows the assumptions are byte-identical apart from created_at; the two changed
- The deck's reviewed HBA III spot is 45.53 (Kepmen 401, 15 Oct 2026), 25% above the 2025 average of 36.50 [F27] and 36% above the company's own 2026 estimate of 32-35 [F47/F48]. The model's FY2026E ASP of 20.82 at 62% rea

Regime stance vs the macro desk is UNASSESSED: IDEATION/CONSTRUCT sets WITH / NEUTRAL / AGAINST before any deep-dive. Fast-disqualify checks and the thesis itself follow the full analyst -> Bear -> Judge law.
